sign: dRRCS = active minus inactive. Positive: stronger in the active model. Negative: stronger in the inactive model.
threshold_rule: Per receptor, contact pairs with |ΔRRCS| at or above mean + SD of |ΔRRCS| (at least 0.2), the threshold each report uses.

layers.order: row-major, one row per receptor in `receptors` order

net.note: net dRRCS of the residue (signed sum over all its contacts) x scale, clipped to +-127

hit.note: number of above-threshold contacts of the residue

aa.note: ASCII one-letter code, '-' where the receptor lacks the position

pos.note: the receptor's own residue number, 0 where it lacks the position

similarity_note: receptors[].similar, links and sim_xy follow the default rule (contact pattern); atlas/rules.json holds every grouping rule with its map, links, neighbor lists and tree, and the definitions.
layout_note: sim_xy: t-SNE (perplexity 22, cosine distance) of the contact-pattern vectors. seq_xy: the same on residue identity at the generic positions. Browsing aids, not classifications.
